_doc: Paste-ready reference for the RevenueCat dashboard. RevenueCat does not accept this JSON as a direct import; the dashboard requires manual configuration. This file is the source of truth — keep it in sync with the live dashboard. See marketing/11-REVENUECAT-AND-IAP-SETUP.md for the operator walkthrough.

ios_app._doc: API key is also referenced in src/config/constants.ts. Don't rotate without updating both.

products._doc: The current product sold to unlocks 1 through 5,000. Cleared for Sale: YES until cutover.
Pre-approved by Apple. Cleared for Sale: NO until unlock #5,001. Same display name on purpose — buyer never sees the v2 suffix.

entitlements._doc: Internal ID is 'pro' for legacy reasons (don't rename — historical purchases would break). Customer-facing copy says 'Lifetime Unlock.' This entitlement grants access to all Lifetime features: secret presets, focus timer, unlimited mixes, background playback, future places.

packages._doc: Swap to '..._v2' on cutover at unlock #5,001. The package identifier ('lifetime') stays the same so the app code keeps working without a release.

webhooks._doc: Generate the secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Save it to the serverless function's env. RevenueCat sends it as the Authorization header on every event.

subscriber_attributes_to_collect._doc: Set these from the iOS client via Purchases.setEmail() / Purchases.setDisplayName() so the welcome email webhook has an address to send to.
subscriber_attributes_to_collect.$email: Set via Purchases.setEmail(email) immediately after first purchase. Required for the welcome email.
subscriber_attributes_to_collect.$displayName: Optional. Used for personalization in the founders wall.
subscriber_attributes_to_collect.ig_handle: Optional. Set via Purchases.setAttributes({ ig_handle: '@handle' }) when the user replies to the welcome email with their handle.

cutover_runbook._doc: Sequence to execute when cumulative lifetime unlocks hit 5,000. Pin a Reel before each step.
steps: 1. App Store Connect → IAP `..._lifetime_unlock` → Cleared for Sale → No.
2. App Store Connect → IAP `..._lifetime_unlock_v2` → Cleared for Sale → Yes.
3. RevenueCat → Offering `default` → Package `lifetime` → swap product reference to `..._lifetime_unlock_v2`.
4. Verify: open App Store on a fresh device, confirm price reads $14.99.
5. Verify: existing owners' Restore Purchase still works (entitlement attached to BOTH products).
6. Pin a new Reel: 'founders wall closed at 5,000. price is $14.99 forever.'

_test_endpoints.sandbox_iap_test: Use scripts/Products.storekit + Xcode StoreKit Configuration for local testing. See marketing/11-REVENUECAT-AND-IAP-SETUP.md Step 6.
